description: Tamper tests: each model/contract tamper scenario denies worker spawn pre-validation

tamper_scenarios.description: On-disk yunet_2023mar.onnx has different content than the manifest declares
tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'tampered model yunet_2023mar: sha256 mismatch'

tamper_scenarios.description: On-disk sface_2021dec.onnx has different content than the manifest declares
tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'tampered model sface_2021dec: sha256 mismatch'

tamper_scenarios.description: On-disk minifasnet_pad.onnx has different content than the manifest declares
tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'tampered model minifasnet_pad: sha256 mismatch'

tamper_scenarios.description: minifasnet_pad.onnx is not present on disk
Manifest declares all-zeros sha256 for yunet_2023mar variant
tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'zero hash in manifest for model yunet_2023mar'

tamper_scenarios.description: ModelSpec.sha256 does not match the manifest variant's sha256
tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'spec hash mismatch for model'

tamper_scenarios.description: Manifest declares target_arch that does not match the current CPU
tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'arch mismatch for model'

tamper_scenarios.description: Manifest tensor contract has empty input shape
tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'tensor contract input shape is empty'

tamper_scenarios.description: Manifest tensor contract declares an unknown dtype

tamper_scenarios.expected: validation fails with 'restricted model requires explicit authorisation'

tamper_scenarios.description: After seccomp sandbox is applied, open() syscall returns EPERM — ONNX Runtime cannot load model files
After seccomp sandbox is applied, socket() syscall returns EPERM — worker cannot make network connections

fail_closed_principle: Every tamper scenario causes validate_against_manifest to return Err, which causes the daemon's run() to return Err, which causes main() to exit with ExitCode::FAILURE. No worker is spawned on any validation failure path.
